Players Committee card image of [[Moff Gideon]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Rebels here (and at adjacent sites if your E-web blaster here) are power -1. When deployed, may ▼ an E-web blaster or an Imperial stormtrooper for -3 Force.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a5142dd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/moffgideon.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/moffgideon.gif] as of commit a5142dd “Tweak set images” (12 May 2020).
